blurb: Guests rent canoes, kayaks, tubes, or tandem boats and can take shuttle buses to river starting points for paddling trips back to Bluff View Landing. Trips range from 6 to 12 miles with options for picnicking, swimming, fishing, and camping along sandbars. Equipment rental prices vary from $25 to $60 per day.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made 7 days prior to trip date with 10% administration fee deducted · Cancellations within 7 days receive rental credit for same paddling season · No show or no call results in no refund · Bluffview Canoe Rental
